title: RSA-5 Residential Single-Family Attached (provisional summary)
text: RSA-5 is a single-family attached (rowhouse) district. Provisional dimensional standards: minimum lot area 1,440 square feet, minimum lot width 16 feet, maximum height 38 feet, and one dwelling unit permitted by-right. These figures are provisional and must be verified against the official Philadelphia Code Title 14 before being relied upon.

title: RM-1 Residential Multi-Family (provisional summary)
text: RM-1 permits single-family, two-family, and multi-family residential uses by-right. Provisional dimensional standards: minimum lot area 1,440 square feet, minimum lot width 16 feet, and maximum height 38 feet. Verify against the official Philadelphia Code Title 14.

title: CMX-2 Commercial Mixed-Use (provisional summary)
text: CMX-2 is a neighborhood commercial mixed-use district that allows commercial and multi-family residential uses, with a provisional maximum height of 38 feet. Verify against the official Philadelphia Code Title 14.
